newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil stable, Russian on offer.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil stable, Russian on offer.

text.p: NWE straight run fuel oil prices remained stable on Tuesday with fresh Russian cargoes appearing in the Baltics to rouse the market.

Traders said five cargoes were on offer over the next week in Klaipeda and St.Petersburg. One European refiner bought a cargo of E4, loading this weekend, at a premium of $2 over the three means and predicted prices would soften.
"The situation is improving today," said the buyer, who on Monday had been lamenting the scarcity of Russian supplies.
There was little buying interest for low sulphur straight run with plentiful volumes overhanging the market.
Buyers said falling crude values might undermine prices in the coming days.
Low sulphur straight run stayed at a notional $105/$108 with no trades done.
